data.name: Ratikanta
data.gender_notes: Ratikanta is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ratikanta is a Sanskrit name which means 'Ruler of the night'. This name is derived from the Hindu god Ratri, the goddess of the night. The name is bestowed upon a child who is believed to have the qualities of a ruler, such as strength, courage, and loyalty. The name Ratikanta carries the meaning “Ruler of the night” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ratikanta usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the night and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of the night and the inner strength of an individual.
data.etymology: Ratikanta belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler of the night.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ratikanta total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ratikanta holds significant cultural importance in Hindu traditions. It is reminiscent of the eternal power and majesty of the night, personified by Goddess Ratri. This name can be seen as a symbol of the depth and richness of Hindu mythology.
data.spiritual_significance: On a more spiritual level, the name Ratikanta carries deep meanings. It implies the presence of the divine within the child, acknowledging their inherent strength and sovereignty over their own lives. The name serves as a reminder of the cyclical nature of life and the balance between day and night, symbolizing the connection between the physical and spiritual realms.
